title: Um dia de praia
en: Rita and Tiago spend Saturday at the beach.

paragraphs.pt: No sábado, a Rita e o Tiago vão à praia do Baleal. Levam toalhas, protetor solar, água e sandes.
paragraphs.en: On Saturday, Rita and Tiago go to Baleal beach. They take towels, sun cream, water and sandwiches.

paragraphs.pt: A água está fria, mas a Rita gosta de nadar. O Tiago prefere ler um livro debaixo do chapéu de sol. Na praia há uma bandeira verde: pode-se nadar.
paragraphs.en: The water is cold, but Rita likes swimming. Tiago prefers reading a book under the sunshade. There's a green flag on the beach: you can swim.

paragraphs.pt: Ao meio-dia, comem as sandes na esplanada do café. Depois, bebem um café e voltam para a areia. Às sete da tarde vão para casa, cansados mas contentes.
paragraphs.en: At noon they eat the sandwiches on the café terrace. Then they have a coffee and go back to the sand. At seven in the evening they go home, tired but happy.

questions.q: Where do Rita and Tiago go?
What does Tiago like to do on the beach?
What does the green flag mean?

glossary.chapéu: hat (chapéu de sol = sunshade, beach umbrella)

notes.en: they go to the beach. a + a = à.
likes swimming. Gostar always takes de.
you can swim / swimming is allowed. The impersonal se (A2): aqui fala-se inglês = English is spoken here.
tired but happy. Adjectives agree: plural because there are two of them.
